mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, policy_code, policy_version, policy_json, policy_hash, enabled FROM em_future_state_policy WHERE enabled = 1 AND (project_id = #{projectId} OR project_id IS NULL) ORDER BY CASE WHEN project_id = #{projectId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS rule_id, r.rule_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metric_code, ''), r.metric_code) AS metric_code, l.level_code, l.level_rank, c.operator, c.threshold_value, c.threshold_value_upper, c.threshold_unit, GREATEST(COALESCE(r.minimum_consecutive_steps, 1), 1) AS minimum_consecutive_steps FROM em_event_rule r JOIN em_event_rule_level l ON l.rule_id = r.id JOIN em_event_rule_condition c ON c.level_id = l.id AND c.required = 1 JOIN ( SELECT level_id FROM em_event_rule_condition WHERE required = 1 GROUP BY level_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ) single_condition ON single_condition.level_id = l.id WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} AND r.enabled = 1 ORDER BY l.level_rank ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT LOWER(event_level) AS riskLevel, COUNT(*) AS eventCount FROM em_monitoring_event WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND UPPER(COALESCE(source_type, 'OBSERVATION')) = 'OBSERVATION' AND LOWER(event_status) NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') GROUP BY LOWER(event_level)
SELECT id AS stationId, COALESCE(NULLIF(station_name, ''), station_code) AS stationName FROM em_station WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND COALESCE(enabled, 1) = 1
